product_metadata.title: Jersey Boys Movie Poster 24 inches x 36 inches
features: Make a statement in your space with our Premium Posters. Produced on quality poster paper for a unique work of art to add to your space.
American posters has a wide range of sizes in our store to ensure a perfect fit in your space.

This poster offers superior sharpness, fine detail, and vivid colors compared to the competition that prints on silk, fabric, vinyl and substandard flat utility paper. Semi-gloss finish, this is not a high gloss or glare item, so it will look great under glass.

American posters products ship rolled from the U S A in heavy cardboard tubes. No extra white borders. American posters does not add borders to art that did not have one originally. Artwork that originally had an edge, will be replicated with an edge.
